Age band mix, Oct 21 2025 to Oct 21 2026 (share of the 14,862,537 unduplicated five-category digital original audience)
- 25-34: 27.8% share, 9.1% penetration. Comedy and Lifestyle lead; Hot Ones, Kill Tony, Chicken Shop Date

- 55-64: 5.7% share, 2.0% penetration. Faith leads; BibleProject, Tiny Desk Concerts

- The audience leans young and platform-native: 54.1% sits 18 to 34 and another 11.2% is 17 and under, a shape closer to the Hazbin Hotel and Fear Street audiences in the library than to a broadcast audience like Shark Tank. Comedy and Horror pull that center of gravity down in age, Faith and Lifestyle pull it up.
- Gender runs near even with a female tilt at 52.8%, but the tilt is category-built rather than audience-wide: Lifestyle / Arts & Culture, Young Adult and Faith read female-leaning, Comedy and the creepypasta end of Horror read male-leaning. A buyer planning across all five is buying a balanced audience; a buyer planning one category is not.
- Intensity is concentrated. The 3,567,009 Avid viewers are 24.0% of the audience and they are the people carrying the cross-platform behavior, with the 2,403,255 who watch on both YouTube and TikTok sitting almost entirely inside that tier. The habit reads as one long-form home on YouTube plus a vertical feed on TikTok, not two separate audiences.
- Commerce behavior skews toward accessible mass and beauty brands in the Nike, Bath & Body Works, Old Navy, CeraVe band that the comparable young digital audiences carry, with creator-adjacent merch and fandom retail (Hot Topic, Redbubble) over-indexing inside the Horror and Young Adult halves.

armine_reads.open_door_read:
On Digital original content categories (Comedy, Lifestyle/Arts & Culture, Faith, Young Adult, Horror):

Comedy is the biggest of the five digital original categories at 6,579,974 US viewers, and the named franchises carrying it are Dropout's Game Changer, Smosh, Kill Tony and Chicken Shop Date.

Comedy digital original audience: 6,579,974, Comedy avid tier: 1,579,989, Comedy avid concentration: 24.0%.

Digital original content category mix, Oct 21 2025 to Oct 21 2026 (share of the five-category digital original viewing signals in the window)
- Comedy: 32.6% share, 3.0% penetration. Game Changer and Dimension 20 (Dropout), Smosh, Kill Tony, Chicken Shop Date, Bad Friends lead
- Lifestyle / Arts & Culture: 25.4% share, 2.4% penetration. Hot Ones, NPR Tiny Desk, AD Open Door, Vogue 73 Questions, Babish lead
- Horror: 16.9% share, 1.6% penetration. The Backrooms (Kane Pixels), MrBallen, Local58 and the Mandela Catalogue, Mr. Nightmare lead
- Young Adult: 14.2% share, 1.3% penetration. Alan's Universe, Dhar Mann Studios, Chicken Girls (Brat TV), Webtoon vertical series lead
- Faith: 10.9% share, 1.0% penetration. BibleProject, The Bible Recap, Girls Gone Bible, Hallow daily audio, The Chosen companion content lead

- Comedy leads because its formats are cheap to repeat and easy to clip: a audience or roast episode seeds ten vertical cutdowns, and the avid tier at 24.0% of the category shows the habit sticking rather than one viral spike. The audience skews 18 to 34 and male-leaning, with Dropout and Kill Tony pulling the heaviest repeat behavior.
- Lifestyle and arts and culture reads as the most premium-friendly block. Hot Ones, Tiny Desk, AD Open Door and Vogue's interview formats are talent-led, brand-safe and sponsorable, and the category skews older and more female than comedy, which is why it carries the single largest title on screen.
- Horror punches above its size on intensity. Analog horror and found-footage serials like The Backrooms and the Mandela Catalogue, plus MrBallen narration, pull a young male core that watches in long sessions, so the category reads smaller on reach but strong on time per viewer.
- Faith is the smallest of the five but the most durable: BibleProject, The Bible Recap and Hallow daily audio run on a daily or weekly ritual rather than discovery, and Girls Gone Bible shows the lane is now recruiting under 30. Young Adult sits between the two, driven by vertical scripted series (Alan's Universe, Dhar Mann Studios, Brat TV) that over-index teen and young female and convert fast on TikTok but churn between seasons.

How these are counted:
- Window: Oct 21 2025 to Oct 21 2026.
- Base: the Digital original content categories (Comedy, Lifestyle/Arts & Culture, Faith, Young Adult, Horror) audience, measured across 10M US consumers and projected to the US.
- People: Counts are US people (persons), each counted once inside the window however many devices or sessions they used; they are not accounts, households or impressions.
